Blockquote containing a list preserves list items inside quote

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<blockquote><p>Quote intro:</p><ul><li>Point one</li><li>Point two</li></ul></blockquote>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
